title: The NHTSA escalates its investigation into Tesla's FSD to an "engineering analysis", a step that could lead to a mandatory recall or other enforcement action (Ryan Felton/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Ryan Felton / Wall Street Journal: The NHTSA escalates its investigation into Tesla's FSD to an “engineering analysis”, a step that could lead to a mandatory recall or other enforcement action — The probe covers about 3.2 million Tesla vehicles — Federal safety regulators are sharpening their focus …
contentText:
Ryan Felton / Wall Street Journal :

The NHTSA escalates its investigation into Tesla's FSD to an “engineering analysis”, a step that could lead to a mandatory recall or other enforcement action   —  The probe covers about 3.2 million Tesla vehicles  —  Federal safety regulators are sharpening their focus …
